seo_title: Brevo vs Mailchimp: Transactional API & SMTP Audit (2026)
meta_description: Brevo wins for high-volume transactional SMTP and API-first stacks. Mailchimp remains a marketing-heavy platform with limited transactional capabilities.
direct_verdict: Brevo is the superior choice for developers and high-volume transactional email needs due to its native SMTP relay and robust API. Mailchimp is better suited for SMB marketing teams prioritizing visual design over technical integration and transactional throughput.

comparison_matrix.product_b_spec: Limited transactional support via Mandrill add-on

comparison_matrix.product_a_spec: High-concurrency RESTful API for transactional triggers
comparison_matrix.product_b_spec: Strict rate limits on marketing-focused API endpoints
Tiered access based on plan level

comparison_matrix.product_a_spec: Direct SFTP and custom object connectors

comparison_matrix.product_b_spec: GDPR compliant with US-centric data processing

product_a_pros: Native SMTP relay for transactional emails
Advanced API documentation and SDK support
product_a_cons: Support response times vary on lower tiers
UI can feel dense for non-technical marketing users
product_b_pros: Industry-leading email design and template library
Strong ecosystem of third-party marketing integrations
product_b_cons: Transactional email requires separate Mandrill configuration
hidden_gotchas: Mailchimp enforces strict contact-based billing, meaning you pay for inactive subscribers, which can lead to massive cost spikes as your list grows. Brevo's transactional SMTP is powerful but requires careful domain authentication (SPF/DKIM/DMARC) setup to avoid deliverability issues, which is often underestimated by teams migrating from simpler platforms. Both platforms have hidden overage fees if you exceed monthly send limits, but Mailchimp's overages are significantly more aggressive regarding account suspension.
